Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: A student mixed 25 grams of salt into 1,000 grams of water. What is the mass of the saltwater mixture?
A. 975 grams
B. 1,000 grams
C. 1,025 grams
D. 2,500 grams
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
